title: Dynamic reserve marketplace & micro-SLA tiers — pricing experiment and contract flow
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Context: Enterprise buyers have asked for more granular SLAs and flexible reserved capacity that can be resold or reallocated across teams. Current Reserved + Burst models are binary (reserved vs. burst) and force large long-term commitments. Proposal: run an experiment that packages reserved GPU capacity as tradable 'reserve units' in a Redwood-managed marketplace and couples them with micro-SLA tiers (99.9x levels and optional latency SLO add-ons). This ticket scopes the experiment, pricing heuristics, contract language changes, and the Security Questionnaire (SQ) impact for Dedicated customers.
approach: Phase A: pricing simulation and buyer interviews (4 weeks). Build a spreadsheet model that simulates utilization curves, resale fees, minimum commitment discounts, and SLA upcharges. Phase B: pilot offer to two strategic customers via addendum (legal + finance sign-off). Phase C: instrument Console and billing to surface reserve unit availability, marketplace transactions, and per-route micro-SLA selection. We will pair pilots with a small Dedicated pool (isolated GPUs) to validate routing and fault isolation behavior.
metrics: Incremental churn delta for customers on marketplace offers (target < 0.5%)
SLO breach rate for micro-tier customers (target < 0.05%)
acceptance_criteria: Pricing model that forecasts unit economics across three demand profiles (steady, spiky, seasonal)
Legal-approved addendum language for resell/reallocation and minimum term adjustments
Mockup in Console for marketplace listing + single-click purchase flow
Billing prototype that records reserve unit issuance, transfer, and applied discounts
SQ checklist updated: KMS key scoping, audit logging for transfers, and admin role restrictions

notes: Trade-offs: opening a marketplace increases sales velocity and lowers friction for customers with variable demand but adds product complexity and audit surface area.
Fallback: if marketplace transfers create unacceptable SQ/legal risk, convert to 'internal reallocation' only and keep resale off-limits.
Longer term: marketplace could enable a secondary capacity market across regions; reserve unit denomination should be region-aware.
